content.short: Connecting African Developers and Entrepreneurs to the Cardano ecosystem.
content.description: Wada provides a platform to the people of Africa and the diaspora to reimagine local socioeconomic models that reflect the culture, and future aspirations. This is done with a focus on decentralization, self-organisation and distributive governance. The three pillars of Wada are infrastructure, education, and dApp creation. Infrastructure: Wada seeks to support local hubs throughout Africa and the African diaspora.
content.meta: Find out about Wada (WADA) on the Cardano Blockchain, so you can make well-informed investment decisions.
